title: Dover Sole Dugléré
description:
By MARK BITTMAN
About 1½ pounds Dover sole or other flatfish fillets, rinsed and patted dry
ingredients: 2 medium tomatoes, diced (blot excess tomato liquid with paper towels).
directions: Heat the oven to 350. Remove the skin from the fish, and sprinkle with salt and pepper, as you like.
Put the butter in the bottom of an ovenproof dish, then add the parsley and tomato. Place the fish fillets across the top.
Cover the top of the dish, and cook for 15 minutes, until the fish is opaque.
Remove the fish with a slotted spoon, and divide it among four plates. Spoon the tomato and parsley onto the fish.
Quickly reduce the butter sauce in a small saucepan on high heat. (Because there is no emulsifier, you are really just cooking off any excess tomato water.) Pour over fish and serve immediately.
